name: Knitting-Library
description: Self-hosted knitting pattern manager with PDF/image uploads, searchable pattern library, annotations, project tracking, and yarn inventory.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent app data, including the SQLite database, uploaded patterns, thumbnails, yarn images, annotations, and settings.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: HTTP port for the Knitting Library web interface.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID used for files written to /data and /logs. Unraid default is 99.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID used for files written to /data and /logs. Unraid default is 100.

variables.name: Trusted Proxies
variables.description: Comma-separated proxy IPs or CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto headers should be trusted. Leave blank when accessing the app directly.

variables.name: Allowed Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated allowed browser origins for CORS. Leave blank for same-origin access.
